name: HeyForm Open Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: AGPL-3.0 self-hosted form builder software; no vendor-imposed subscription or response quota for the self-hosted software. Server and database capacity are self-managed.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires infrastructure, database and maintenance; AGPL-3.0 source-disclosure obligations apply to modifications. Commercializing a modified HeyForm version requires additional attribution and links per the official license guidance. Hosted HeyForm plans/trials are separate and not included.
